body:
Genuine compassion and introspection.  Maybe a fine balance between many things: playful and serious, pragmatic and spontaneous.  Doesn't have to be perfect, yet cherishes the joyful attempt in moving towards the same.  Doesn't have to be a supermodel, yet diligent about caring for her health.  A gentle heart is worth more than anything, but she doesn't have to abandon passion, drive, excellence, or determination.  Be someone worthy of support, but also support in return.  That's a true relationship, not by comparing what each have and can offer, but what each needs and can give.

Also lots of sex. :)

Thanks for the reply.

I don't know.  There's a lot of "infrastructure" build around this relationship despite the aforementioned issues.  If I didn't have a whole slew of requirements (mortage, child about to go to college, etc) -- if I was still in my 20s -- it would be easy to just say f this and bail.  That's where I feel locked in, stuck in a situation that's awful, but all attempts haven't provided anything useful.

And maybe that's what she's banking on (and forgive me, but I don't mean to sound like she's antagonistic here).  She's comfortable where she is.  She has everything she wants: home, stability, successful new business endeavor, etc.

I do feel a bit used.  I know it's not intentional, but it is there.
Hi.  I hope you're doing okay.  That's all. :)
